name: Ram Mandir
town_description: Mamit is the headquarters town of Mamit district in western Mizoram, near the Tripura border. It is a small administrative and market town set in the foothills of the Mizo hills, with the Dampa Tiger Reserve lying to its south.

travel.airport: Lengpui Airport (Aizawl) is the nearest airport, then road to Mamit (verify timings locally)
travel.railway: Silchar (Assam) is the nearest major railway station (verify)
